reviewedBoundaries: Git objects own source history and concurrency; logical Domain-through-Task identities and semantic Spec/Plan revisions remain distinct.
Actual answers, interpretations, observations, verification, native execution, delivery, formal completion and Acceptance remain distinct.
The shared Runtime Index selects bounded official documentation only; it grants no execution, authentication, billing or permission decision.
No automatic merge or review-arrival observer remains; exact-head independent review and accountable explicit Lead merge remain required.
Existing native engines, active configuration, sessions, hooks, trust, credentials and original/evidence stores retain their owners.
Legacy interfaces, native plugin source guards and immutable release archives are preserved.
limitations: This conclusion verifies common source and CI quality for the exact commit/tree/complete manifest. It is not GitHub integration, deployed runtime behavior, native activation, consumer Acceptance or whole-Work Acceptance.
Synthetic native occurrence/receiver fixtures verify structural joins only. No actual native occurrence, attempt, authentication or receiver delivery is invented for the real source-only Work Tasks.
The original both-runtime Work remains unaccepted. WSL2/VPS Leads must separately verify and explicitly activate the completed merged source.
A changed tree requires renewed independent review. Any same-tree successor commit requires an explicit independent binding and a current zero-unresolved-finding check.
The reviewer did not publish evidence/status, open or merge a PR, activate a runtime, run a paid/native model evaluation suite, or mutate the candidate.
